params.source:
--!strict
-- The native Spinner system, driven through the Spin action: Main.scene's Spinner turns 90 deg/s about Y and the
-- Wheel -45 deg/s about its own Y while Spin is held. Luau cannot read native components, so the cases read the
-- Transform the system writes.

local function Yaw(name: string): number
	local found = Scene.FindByName(name)
	Test.Expect(found ~= nil, `Main.scene has a {name} entity`)
	return (found :: Entity).Transform.EulerAngles.y
end

return Test.Suite("Spinner", function()
	Test.Case("stays still without input", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectNear(Yaw("Spinner"), 0, 0.0001, "the Spinner did not turn")
		Test.ExpectNear(Yaw("Wheel"), 0, 0.0001, "the Wheel did not turn")
	end)

	Test.Case("turns at its speed while Spin is held", function()
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectNear(Yaw("Spinner"), 90, 0.01, "the Spinner turned 90 degrees in one second")
		Test.ExpectNear(Yaw("Wheel"), -45, 0.01, "the Wheel turned -45 degrees in one second")
	end)

	Test.Case("stops turning when Spin is released", function()
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		local released = Yaw("Spinner")
		Test.Expect(released > 40, "the Spinner turned while Spin was held")
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectEqual(Yaw("Spinner"), released, "the Spinner keeps its angle once Spin is released")
	end)

	Test.Case("wraps its angle after a full turn", function()
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(250)
		Test.InjectAction("Spin", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(2)
		Test.ExpectNear(Yaw("Spinner"), 15, 0.01, "250 ticks at 1.5 degrees each is 375 degrees, one turn and 15")
	end, { TimeoutTicks = 400 })
end)

--!strict
-- The native Bumper system, driven through the Bump action: Main.scene's Bumper rests at 0.5 m, climbs 0.5 m per
-- press and drops back after 4 presses. Luau cannot read native components, so the cases read the Transform the
-- system writes.

local function Height(): number
	local found = Scene.FindByName("Bumper")
	Test.Expect(found ~= nil, "Main.scene has a Bumper entity")
	return (found :: Entity).Transform.Translation.y
end

local function Press()
	Test.InjectAction("Bump", "Tap")
	Test.WaitTicks(5)
end

return Test.Suite("Bumper", function()
	Test.Case("rests at its base height without input", function()
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 0.5, 0.0001, "the Bumper stayed at its base height")
	end)

	Test.Case("climbs one step per press", function()
		Press()
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 1.0, 0.0001, "one press raised it one step")
		Press()
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 1.5, 0.0001, "two presses raised it two steps")
	end)

	Test.Case("counts a held Bump once", function()
		Test.InjectAction("Bump", "Down")
		Test.WaitTicks(30)
		Test.InjectAction("Bump", "Up")
		Test.WaitTicks(5)
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 1.0, 0.0001, "holding Bump for 30 ticks is one press")
	end)

	Test.Case("drops back after its last level", function()
		Press()
		Press()
		Press()
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 2.0, 0.0001, "three presses reach the top level")
		Press()
		Test.ExpectNear(Height(), 0.5, 0.0001, "the fourth press drops it back to its base height")
	end)
end)

--!strict
-- The recording suite of Assets/Tests/Replays/SpinAndBump.replay: a planned input list that holds Spin for 90 ticks
-- and presses Bump three times, so the native systems turn the Spinner 135 degrees and raise the Bumper to its top
-- level. It only reads the scene and injects input.

type Step = { Tick: number, Action: string, State: "Down" | "Up" | "Tap" }

local Plan: { Step } = {
	{ Tick = 10, Action = "Spin", State = "Down" },
	{ Tick = 40, Action = "Bump", State = "Tap" },
	{ Tick = 70, Action = "Bump", State = "Tap" },
	{ Tick = 100, Action = "Spin", State = "Up" },
	{ Tick = 130, Action = "Bump", State = "Tap" },
}

return Test.Suite("Record.SpinAndBump", function()
	Test.Case("spins and bumps", function()
		local spinner = Scene.FindByName("Spinner")
		local bumper = Scene.FindByName("Bumper")
		Test.Expect(spinner ~= nil and bumper ~= nil, "Main.scene has a Spinner and a Bumper")
		local tick = 0
		for _, step in Plan do
			Test.WaitTicks(step.Tick - tick)
			tick = step.Tick
			Test.InjectAction(step.Action, step.State)
		end
		Test.WaitTicks(60)
		Test.ExpectNear((spinner :: Entity).Transform.EulerAngles.y, 135, 0.01, "holding Spin for 90 ticks turned the Spinner 135 degrees")
		Test.ExpectNear((bumper :: Entity).Transform.Translation.y, 2.0, 0.0001, "three presses of Bump raised the Bumper to its top level")
	end)
end)
